evals.name: compare-progress
evals.prompt: A library observer has no last-handled position. Later it reports last handled 42 and next 43 for a write at 50. Diagnose both readings.
evals.expected_output: A position comparison only after scope checks.
assertions: Verifies acceptance and matches store, namespace and sequence.
Guards last.IsActualValue before comparing positions and reports the next position for a lagging observer.
Distinguishes lag from registration failure and avoids replaying the observer.

evals.name: isolate-failure
evals.prompt: The observer passed position 9 but one author is missing from the listing. Another partition has failed. What do you inspect?
assertions: Checks completion for the affected write.
Matches the affected observer and partition rather than blaming an unrelated failure.
Does not equate a reached position with downstream success.

evals.name: missing-job
evals.prompt: Diagnose progress using the observer jobs without changing the running service.
assertions: Lists jobs before requesting the specific job ID.
Handles a missing job without reporting completion.
Does not stop the job, remove the observer or start replay.
